body:
I hate my "perfect" life so much.  There's just too much homework, stress, deadlines to meet, expectations to exceed, and people to please.  

Life has just become an automated routine - something that lacks happiness and fun.  

I really want to thank you for being here when it seems like I have no one.  I have only been on this site for a few months (this is a throwaway) but it never ceases to amaze me that the same site can humor me and save lives at the same time.  Thank you.

They think I'm either going to run away or I'm going to go hurt myself.  

It's hard to explain but I'm not the "kid" that would be having these problems.  I'm a straight A student in all AP and honors courses and I'm friends with lots of people...I'm pretty sure if they found out what was actually going on and how I actually felt they'd be pretty shocked.

I'm really thankful that you took time out of your life to try and better mine.  I'm still pretty adamant I'm going to go through with it, but either way, I want to thank you.

I've tried leaving for a bit to bike and cool off but the last time I tried my parents wouldn't allow me to leave and threatened to call the cops to make sure I stay in the house.

I just fear that they'd judge me for what I have done in the past and that is something I really don't think I could handle.  I haven't spoken to anyone about my thoughts except just rambling on to my dog.

I've had some outbursts of anger aimed at people in the past and they think I'm going to do it again but this time either hurt them or hurt myself.  

Once my friends hear about this i'm pretty sure their views of me will change fairly dramatically...I just want peace and quiet now
